front.title: IS-IS, OSPF, BGP-LS, and BGP Extensions for Advertising STAMP Session-Reflectors

abstract.t: The Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP), as defined in RFC 8762, can be utilized for active measurement without relying on a control channel to pre-signal session parameters. This document defines extensions to IS-IS, OSPF, BGP-LS, and BGP to advertise information for discovering STAMP Session-Reflectors in a network. The advertised information can be used by STAMP senders to set up appropriate performance measurement sessions for delay and packet loss metrics.
